title: EHR user and role report
what_it_shows: Named accounts: the owner's practice-administrator account and named billing-role accounts for billing company staff, each created by the owner; no written access request is attached to any account; no record of a user list review

title: EHR sign-in and MFA settings
what_it_shows: The vendor enforces MFA on every account; the owner's phone is the only registered second factor and no backup sign-in method is set up; session timeout is set by the vendor

title: EHR audit log screen and report history
what_it_shows: Sign-in and record-access logging is on for every user and can be filtered and exported; the practice's report history shows no audit report run or export since the account was opened

title: Email and file account security page and storage review
what_it_shows: Personal consumer plan in the owner's name; password sign-in, with two-step verification available and turned off; the provider keeps a sign-in history; the mailbox holds messages with patient documents from referring offices and labs; file storage holds practice documents including patient records; no file version history on this plan; the junk folder holds phishing messages received in the last 30 days

title: Email and file provider plan terms
what_it_shows: The consumer plan terms contain no business associate terms; the provider offers a BAA only with its business plans

title: Cloud fax portal account settings
what_it_shows: Password sign-in; two-step verification is supported and turned off; faxes are sent and received through the vendor's encrypted web portal

title: Laptop and tablet settings review
what_it_shows: Laptop: automatic OS updates on and update history current; built-in antivirus on with real-time protection; host firewall on; full-disk encryption off; screen lock after 15 minutes; no backup configured; the downloads folder holds exported patient documents; the IT consultant's remote-support tool is installed. Tablet: passcode set, device encryption on, lock after 1 minute, automatic updates on

title: Mobile phone settings and content review
what_it_shows: Passcode set and device encryption on; automatic updates on; remote wipe not set up; phone backup off; the camera roll holds clinical photos of skin conditions, some of which also appear in EHR charts; patient text threads in the standard SMS app; the EHR second factor and the AI scribe app are on this phone

title: Building Wi-Fi tenant notice and network check
source_system: Building management email; laptop network settings (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: The building provides tenant Wi-Fi; the suite's network name has its own password; the notice states that all tenant network names run on one shared building network managed by the landlord

title: Exam suite lease
what_it_shows: Florida exam suite in a shared medical office building; the landlord controls building entrances and reception, holds a master key to the suite, and records lock and door repairs; the building provides a locked shredding bin for tenants

title: Exam suite walk-through
what_it_shows: Building entry through reception; suite door on a keyed lock; paper chart cabinet locked; locked building shredding bin in the hallway; the owner carries the laptop between home and the suite; office practices such as locking the suite are not written down

title: Building shredding service notice
what_it_shows: Locked bins are emptied by the building's shredding contractor; destruction certificates go to building management, not to tenants; the notice says nothing about electronic media

title: Business associate agreement inventory
what_it_shows: Signed BAAs with the EHR vendor, the billing company, the cloud fax vendor, and the on-call IT consultant (signed 2026-07-17); none located for the email and file provider, the answering service, or the AI scribe app

title: Bank and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-07-12
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the EHR vendor, the consumer email and file plan, the cloud fax vendor, the answering service, the billing company, the accounting SaaS, the phone carrier, and the professional liability insurer; hourly payments to the IT consultant; no payment for a standalone cyber insurance policy

title: IT consultant invoices, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
what_it_shows: Hourly invoices for laptop and Wi-Fi help, including remote sessions on the laptop before the BAA was signed on 2026-07-17

title: Answering service agreement and message delivery settings
source_system: Signed agreements folder; answering service portal
what_it_shows: Standard service terms with no business associate or privacy terms; after-hours messages, including patient names and call reasons, are sent to the owner's mobile phone by text

title: Billing company agreement and payer enrollments
what_it_shows: The billing company works claims in the EHR/PM through named billing-role accounts and submits claims electronically to Medicare, Florida Medicaid and commercial plans on the practice's behalf; Medicare and Florida Medicaid enrollment records and commercial plan contracts list a primary care physician practice

title: Billing company claims and collections reports, January to June 2026
what_it_shows: About $3,500 in charges billed per week; all claims submitted electronically

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the tax preparer)
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Active patient and visit volume report, Q2 2026
what_it_shows: About 900 active patients; about 12 visits per clinic day; clinic 4 days a week, about 200 clinic days a year

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; file account; email account; paper files
what_it_shows: No written security policy, procedure, risk analysis, incident plan or contact list, contingency plan, sanctions rule, retention rule, Security Officer designation, or device list was found

title: CME and training record
what_it_shows: CME certificates for the current license cycle cover clinical topics; no HIPAA security course or security reminder subscription appears

title: Phone carrier order history
what_it_shows: The previous phone was traded in through the carrier on 2025-04-12; no wipe confirmation is kept

title: EHR vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: EHR vendor (provided under a nondisclosure agreement)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31; the system description states RTO 4 hours and RPO 1 hour; lists complementary user entity controls; the hosting provider and the e-prescribing network are carved-out subservice organizations

title: EHR clinical decision support settings
what_it_shows: Preventive care and drug interaction reminder rules are on; the vendor's rule descriptions list age, sex, problem list and medications as inputs

title: AI scribe app install record and in-app history
source_system: Phone app store purchase history; AI scribe app (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: App installed on the phone on 2026-07-06 under a free trial; the in-app history lists about 96 recorded visits from 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-17 across 8 clinic days

title: AI scribe app terms of service, as accepted
what_it_shows: Click-through consumer terms with no business associate terms; the vendor may keep recordings and use them to improve its service

title: EHR chart search for recording consent
what_it_shows: No consent note or consent form for audio recording in the charts of the trial visits; the EHR has no recording consent template

title: Professional liability policy declarations
what_it_shows: Professional liability coverage in force for 2026; no cyber endorsement is listed on the declarations page; the full policy form was requested from the agent

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Physician-owner's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the owner is the only person who performs or authorizes each function

title: Risk walk-through of devices and accounts
source_system: Walk-through of the laptop, phone and SaaS accounts with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: Where PHI ends up day to day (EHR, laptop downloads folder, camera roll, SMS threads, mailbox, answering service texts); how the laptop travels between home and the suite; the phishing messages in the mailbox; the consultant's remote sessions before the BAA

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Physician-owner's written answers to the HIPAA safeguard questions, checked on screen with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: Passwords are reused across accounts with no password manager; the laptop is used at home and is sometimes left in the car; billing company accounts are added after a phone request; no copy of local files is made before a device is repaired or replaced; the previous phone was traded in without a documented wipe; incidents would be handled as they arise; the EHR vendor and billing company BAAs contain subcontractor terms, and the fax and IT consultant BAAs were not read for them

title: Control assessment: Device lock test
source_system: Device lock settings; idle test on the laptop and tablet
what_it_shows: Laptop locked after 15 minutes idle and the tablet after 1 minute; the lock held until the password was entered on both devices

title: Control assessment: Activity review self-review
source_system: EHR audit log screen; email sign-in history; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The EHR audit log and the email sign-in history have never been reviewed; no process exists to act on review results or to increase review after an incident or vendor notice

title: Control assessment: Backup review
source_system: EHR vendor SOC 2 report; laptop and phone storage review; file account settings; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The EHR vendor backs up the system and protects backup confidentiality, integrity and availability (SOC 2 report, no exceptions); downloaded files and clinical photos on the laptop and phone have no backup; security documents are kept only in the consumer file account with no versioning

title: Control assessment: EHR MFA sign-in test
source_system: EHR security settings; sign-in test from a new browser
what_it_shows: Practice-administrator sign-in to the EHR required the second factor on the phone

title: Control assessment: Email and fax MFA sign-in test
source_system: Email and cloud fax account security pages; sign-in tests from a new browser
what_it_shows: Email and cloud fax signed in with a password only; MFA is available on both and turned off

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting self-review
source_system: Contact lists; BAAs (reporting clauses); owner self-review
what_it_shows: No reporting time is defined; the answering service has no duty to report; there is no list of whom to notify (EHR vendor, billing company, counsel, HHS)

title: Control assessment: Risk analysis review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk analysis identifies 15 threat events, rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2, includes harm to patients, and is documented; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: Vendor and remote-support review
source_system: BAA folder; vendor list; EHR vendor SOC 2 report; remote-support tool settings on the laptop
what_it_shows: The email and file provider, answering service and AI scribe app handled PHI with no BAA; no vendor list or oversight steps documented; only the EHR vendor is monitored (SOC 2 review 2026-07-23); billing company role set in the EHR; the IT consultant's remote-support tool had unattended access turned on, and the owner turned it off during the session

title: Control assessment: Encryption status check
source_system: Laptop, tablet and phone encryption status screens; EHR vendor SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: Laptop full-disk encryption off; tablet and phone encrypted; EHR data encrypted by the vendor

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection test
source_system: Antivirus status page; standard antivirus test file downloaded
what_it_shows: The built-in antivirus detected the test file on download and quarantined it; signature updates install automatically (last update the same day); scheduled and real-time scans on; the alert was shown to the owner; no false positives recorded
